semiconductor_relevance: High — Yoshikawakogyo RF Semicon operates as a semiconductor test house and develops RFID chips, making it relevant in the semiconductor testing and manufacturing services sector.
summary: Yoshikawakogyo RF Semicon Co., Ltd. is a semiconductor test house based in Japan, specializing in COB/Assembly module mounting and the development and sale of RFID chips. The company leverages its extensive experience to enhance customer cost efficiency and reduce turnaround times in semiconductor testing.

regional_presence.Japan: The company is headquartered in Shintomi-cho, Koyu-gun, Miyazaki Prefecture, Japan.
